title: "Example QC on each sample using custom threshold based on tapering of the violin plots"
output: html_notebook

#### Test density function
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(tibble)
})

# ----------------------------
# 1. LOAD OBJECTS
# ----------------------------
source("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Kaech Lab Folder/Valisha/CORE SCRIPTS/HELPER SCRIPTS/Read_perSampleOuts.R")

base_dir <- "/path/to/per_sample_outs"
all_sample_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

objs <- list()

for (sample in all_sample_dirs) {
  file_path <- file.path(sample, "count", "sample_raw_feature_bc_matrix")
  message(file_path)

  sample_id <- basename(sample)
  message(sample_id)

  counts <- read_10x_any(file_path)

  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = sample_id,
    min.cells = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )

  obj$sample <- sample_id

  if (any(grepl("^MT-", rownames(obj)))) {
    obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  } else if (any(grepl("^mt-", rownames(obj)))) {
    obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^mt-")
  } else {
    obj[["percent.mt"]] <- 0
  }

  colnames(obj) <- paste0(obj$sample[1], "_", colnames(obj))
  objs[[obj$sample[1]]] <- obj
}

stopifnot(length(objs) > 0)
message(sprintf("Loaded %d samples", length(objs)))

```

### Find the taper areas
```{r}

# ----------------------------
# 2. TAPER / KNEE FUNCTIONS
# ----------------------------

get_taper_threshold <- function(x, adjust = 1, frac_peak = 0.10, min_after_mode = 10) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(unique(x)) < 10) {
    return(list(
      threshold = NA_real_,
      mode = NA_real_,
      density = NULL
    ))
  }

  d <- density(x, adjust = adjust, na.rm = TRUE)

  i_mode <- which.max(d$y)
  x_mode <- d$x[i_mode]
  y_mode <- d$y[i_mode]

  xr <- d$x[i_mode:length(d$x)]
  yr <- d$y[i_mode:length(d$y)]

  idx <- which(yr <= frac_peak * y_mode)
  idx <- idx[idx > min_after_mode]

  threshold <- if (length(idx) > 0) xr[idx[1]] else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  list(
    threshold = as.numeric(threshold),
    mode = as.numeric(x_mode),
    density = d
  )
}

make_qc_thresholds_table <- function(
  objs,
  nCount_low = 200,
  nFeature_low = 200,
  mt_high = 3,
  adjust = 1,
  frac_peak = 0.05 ### lower the value more linient is the QC
) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(objs), function(s) {
    obj <- objs[[s]]

    nc <- get_taper_threshold(obj$nCount_RNA, adjust = adjust, frac_peak = frac_peak)
    nf <- get_taper_threshold(obj$nFeature_RNA, adjust = adjust, frac_peak = frac_peak)

    tibble(
      sample = s,
      nCount_low = nCount_low,
      nCount_high = round(nc$threshold),
      nFeature_low = nFeature_low,
      nFeature_high = round(nf$threshold),
      mt_high = mt_high,
      nCount_mode = round(nc$mode),
      nFeature_mode = round(nf$mode)
    )
  }))
}

# ----------------------------
# 3. BUILD QC THRESHOLDS TABLE
# ----------------------------

qc_thresholds <- make_qc_thresholds_table(
  objs = objs,
  nCount_low = 200,
  nFeature_low = 200,
  mt_high = 3,
  adjust = 1,
  frac_peak = 0.08
)

print(qc_thresholds)
# write.csv(qc_thresholds, "qc_thresholds_taper_based.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

### Plot with threshold lines
```{r}

# ----------------------------
# 4. PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ----------------------------

plot_qc_with_custom_thresholds <- function(obj, sample_name, thr_row) {
  p1 <- VlnPlot(obj, features = "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0, layer = "counts") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr_row$nCount_low, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr_row$nCount_high, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    ggtitle(sample_name) +
    NoLegend()

  p2 <- VlnPlot(obj, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0, layer = "counts") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr_row$nFeature_low, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr_row$nFeature_high, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    ggtitle("nFeature") +
    NoLegend()

  p3 <- VlnPlot(obj, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0, layer = "counts") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr_row$mt_high, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    ggtitle("percent.mt") +
    NoLegend()

  p1 | p2 | p3
}

for (s in names(objs)) {
  thr_row <- qc_thresholds %>% filter(sample == s)
  print(plot_qc_with_custom_thresholds(objs[[s]], s, thr_row))
}

```

### Apply the custom threshold
```{r}

# ----------------------------
# 6. APPLY QC
# ----------------------------

objs_qc <- list()
qc_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(objs), function(s) {
  obj <- objs[[s]]
  thr <- qc_thresholds %>% filter(sample == s)

  obj_filt <- subset(
    obj,
    subset =
      nCount_RNA >= thr$nCount_low &
      nCount_RNA <= thr$nCount_high &
      nFeature_RNA >= thr$nFeature_low &
      nFeature_RNA <= thr$nFeature_high &
      percent.mt <= thr$mt_high
  )

  objs_qc[[s]] <<- obj_filt

  tibble(
    sample = s,
    cells_before = ncol(obj),
    cells_after = ncol(obj_filt),
    removed = ncol(obj) - ncol(obj_filt)
  )
}))

print(qc_summary)
write.csv(qc_summary, "qc_summary_taper_based.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

### Replot after QC
```{r}

# ----------------------------
# 7. POST-QC PLOTS
# ----------------------------

# pdf("QC_post_filter_with_taper_thresholds.pdf", width = 12, height = 4)

for (s in names(objs_qc)) {
  thr_row <- qc_thresholds %>% filter(sample == s)
  print(plot_qc_with_custom_thresholds(objs_qc[[s]], paste0(s, "_postQC"), thr_row))
}
```
